inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 4th March, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) has warned of active northwesterly winds affecting various areas across the UAE, expected to be fresh to strong at times, causing blowing dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 2,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The centre stated that the expected weather conditions began at 14:55 and continue until 19:00 this evening. It urged members of the public to exercise caution, especially while driving on open roads, due to the possibility of reduced horizontal visibility caused by blowing dust.

inputs.source: illustrative rumour written for this test
inputs.text: Social media post (unverified): a dam near Al Ain has burst, everyone leave the area now

requested_area.areaDesc: Coastal and inland areas, Abu Dhabi (demo zone)

fields.description: NCM warning: fresh to strong northwesterly winds are causing blowing dust and sand. Visibility is below 2,000 m in some coastal and inland areas. Conditions continue until 19:00 today, 4 March.
fields.headline: Blowing dust and sand reducing visibility in coastal and inland areas until 19:00
fields.instruction: Take extra care, especially when driving on open roads, as visibility may drop suddenly. Updates: https://alerts.example.ae
left_out: Input 2 (social media post claiming a dam near Al Ain has burst and urging evacuation): unverified rumour with no official confirmation. Including it could cause unnecessary panic or evacuation, so it was excluded.
fields.note_for_reviewer: NCM's warning covers various areas across the UAE without naming Abu Dhabi specifically, so the alert relies on the operator-chosen demo zone. Please confirm the 19:00 end time is still current before sending, since the NCM warning was issued during the event (from 14:55).

versions.description: تحذير من المركز الوطني للأرصاد (NCM): رياح شمالية غربية نشطة إلى قوية تتسبب في تطاير الغبار والرمال. مدى الرؤية أقل من 2,000 م في بعض المناطق الساحلية والداخلية. تستمر هذه الأحوال حتى الساعة 19:00 اليوم، 4 مارس.
versions.headline: غبار ورمال متطايرة تقلل مدى الرؤية في المناطق الساحلية والداخلية حتى الساعة 19:00
versions.instruction: توخَّ مزيداً من الحذر، خاصة عند القيادة على الطرق المفتوحة، إذ قد ينخفض مدى الرؤية فجأة. التحديثات: https://alerts.example.ae
